INSERT INTO private.matchup_forecast_queue AS queued(matchup_id, revision, changed_at, dirty)
  SELECT matchup.id, $3, transaction_timestamp(), $4
  FROM public.matchups matchup
  JOIN public.league_seasons season ON season.id=matchup.league_season_id AND season.is_current
  JOIN public.leagues league ON league.id=matchup.league_id AND league.deleted_at IS NULL
  JOIN public.season_weeks first_week ON first_week.season_year=season.season_year AND first_week.week_number=matchup.week_number
  JOIN public.season_weeks last_week ON last_week.season_year=season.season_year AND last_week.week_number=COALESCE(matchup.end_week_number,matchup.week_number)
  WHERE NOT matchup.is_voided
    AND (p_league_id IS NULL OR matchup.league_id=p_league_id)
    AND (p_matchup_id IS NULL OR matchup.id=p_matchup_id)
    AND last_week.week_end >= (now() AT TIME ZONE $5)::date - $6
    AND first_week.week_start <= (now() AT TIME ZONE $7)::date + $8
  ORDER BY matchup.id
  ON CONFLICT(matchup_id) DO UPDATE SET
    revision=CASE WHEN queued.changed_at=transaction_timestamp() THEN queued.revision ELSE queued.revision+$9 END,
    changed_at=transaction_timestamp(), dirty=$10, available_at=now()

INSERT INTO public.league_change_hints AS stored(league_id,topic,revision,scopes)
      VALUES(v_change.league_id,v_topic,$22,v_change.scopes)
    ON CONFLICT(league_id,topic) DO UPDATE SET
      revision=stored.revision+(stored.xmin<>pg_current_xact_id()::xid)::integer,
      scopes=CASE WHEN stored.xmin<>pg_current_xact_id()::xid THEN EXCLUDED.scopes
        WHEN stored.scopes IS NULL OR EXCLUDED.scopes IS NULL THEN $23
        WHEN (SELECT count(DISTINCT scope) FROM jsonb_array_elements(stored.scopes||EXCLUDED.scopes) scope)>$24 THEN $25
        ELSE (SELECT jsonb_agg(scope ORDER BY scope::text) FROM
          (SELECT DISTINCT scope FROM jsonb_array_elements(stored.scopes||EXCLUDED.scopes) scope) merged) END,
      updated_at=clock_timestamp()
    WHERE stored.xmin<>pg_current_xact_id()::xid
      OR stored.scopes IS NOT NULL AND (EXCLUDED.scopes IS NULL OR NOT stored.scopes @> EXCLUDED.scopes)
